uncertainties.issue: "kakkan" = each ship (the motherships; at least the Tower and the Nadesico per the two marker sets). "kan no shatei ni osameru" -> bring within the ships' (weapon) range.
Ten markers distributed by phrase to mimic the source pacing; exact timing unverifiable without a build.
"Flail" is only a provisional glossary term (proposals_dialogue_00696 + Encyclopedia title); used as is. "yoyuu ga areba engo" compressed to "support them if you can" to fit 128.

checked_decisions: Slot 20 ruling: "kakkan" = each (mother)ship, the two marker sets confirm two ships; "within the ships' range" correct.
Slot 22 ruling: marker distribution by phrase accepted; order identical.

Slot 24 ruling: "Flail" matches encyclopedia_021_a/022 and released dialogue; provisional glossary status noted. "support them if you can" keeps yoyuu ga areba; nothing lost. Passive keeps the unnamed deployer open. "at least slow the enemy" renders the contrastive wa correctly.
Slot 23: reordering (ships before units) keeps the meaning "only hit the units in front of the ships"; <danger(1)> stays inside the first clause as in the source.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 22: ten markers, timing only checkable in a build.
Slot 24: "Flail" is still provisional in the glossary.
